translations.web: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.
translations.bsb: May the LORD judge between you and me, and may the LORD take vengeance on you, but my hand will never be against you.
translations.kjv: The LORD judge between me and thee, and the LORD avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
translations.asv: Jehovah judge between me and thee, and Jehovah avenge me of thee; but my hand shall not be upon thee.
